Part B Script (to be read)
Invented texts. Three songs, each to read twice with 30 Second pause. 1 · News.
⁧وَإِلَى أَبْرَزِ الأَنْبَاءِ: أَعْلَنَ البَنْكُ المَرْكَزِيُّ اليَوْمَ رَفْعَ سِعْرِ الفَائِدَةِ الرَّئِيسِيِّ بِنِصْفِ نُقْطَةٍ لِيَبْلُغَ تِسْعَةً⁩
⁧وَفِي الشَّأْنِ القَضَائِيِّ، أَلْغَتِ المَحْكَمَةُ الإِدَارِيَّةُ⁩ — ⁧بِالمِئَةِ، مُبَرِّرًا قَرَارَهُ بِاسْتِمْرَارِ الضُّغُوطِ التَّضَخُّمِيَّةِ.⁩
⁧قَرَارًا وِزَارِيًّا بِإِغْلَاقِ ثَلَاثِ مَدَارِسَ رِيفِيَّةٍ، بَعْدَ دَعْوَى رَفَعَهَا أَوْلِيَاءُ أُمُورِ التَّلَامِيذِ. وَيُمْكِنُ لِلْوِزَارَةِ⁩
⁧وَأَخِيرًا، أَفَادَتْ مَصَادِرُ طِبِّيَّةٌ بِإِصَابَةِ مَا لَا يَقِلُّ عَنْ خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ شَخْصًا فِي⁩ — ⁧الطَّعْنُ فِي الحُكْمِ.⁩
⁧اشْتِبَاكَاتٍ قُرْبَ الحُدُودِ، وَلَمْ يَتَسَنَّ التَّحَقُّقُ مِنْ هٰذِهِ الحَصِيلَةِ مِنْ مَصْدَرٍ مُسْتَقِلٍّ.⁩
⁧أَوْلِيَاءُ الأُمُورِ⁩ • parents. 2 · Communicate.
⁧اِخْتَتَمَ وَزِيرُ الخَارِجِيَّةِ وَنَظِيرُهُ اليُونَانِيُّ مُبَاحَثَاتِهِمَا فِي أَثِينَا أَمْسِ، فِي أَجْوَاءٍ وَصَفَهَا بَيَانٌ مُشْتَرَكٌ⁩
⁧وَاتَّفَقَ الجَانِبَانِ عَلَى تَعْزِيزِ التَّعَاوُنِ فِي مَجَالَيِ السِّيَاحَةِ وَالطَّاقَةِ المُتَجَدِّدَةِ،⁩ .« ⁧وُدِّيَّةٌ وَبَنَّاءَةٌ⁩ » ⁧بِأَنَّهَا⁩
⁧بِشَأْنِهِ،⁩ « ⁧تَبَادَلَ الجَانِبَانِ وُجُهَاتِ النَّظَرِ⁩ » ⁧وَعَلَى تَشْكِيلِ لَجْنَةٍ مُشْتَرَكَةٍ. أَمَّا مَلَفُّ الصَّيْدِ البَحْرِيِّ، فَقَدْ⁩
⁧وَاتَّفَقَا عَلَى مُوَاصَلَةِ التَّشَاوُرِ. وَلَمْ يُحَدِّدِ البَيَانُ مَوْعِدَ الاِجْتِمَاعِ الأَوَّلِ لِلَّجْنَةِ.⁩
⁧المُتَجَدِّدَة⁩ "Renewable" is defined as "renewable." 3 · Egyptian story (to be read to an Egyptian speaker).
⁧اسمع يا سيدي اللي حصلي امبارح. كنت راكن العربية قدام البيت، وطلعت أجيب حاجة من فوق،⁩
⁧خمس دقايق بالظبط. نزلت، وإلا عسكري المرور واقف جنب العربية وبيكتب مخالفة! قلتله يا باشا،⁩
⁧أنا كنت خمس دقايق بس. قالي إن الركنة هنا ممنوعة، وسألني لو كنت شايف اليافطة. بصيت،⁩
⁧لقيت يافطة صغيرة ورا الشجرة! قلتله والله ما شفتها. الراجل ضحك، وقالي المرة دي هسيبك، بس⁩
⁧ما تركنش هنا تاني. والحمد لله، ما دفعتش ولا مليم!⁩

A · Reading

1. A service of politics and economy (news with analysis: data, conflicting voices, experts, context). The Parliament approved (ratified) the gas supply agreement with the Kingdom of Oasis, signed during the President's State visit in spring: 112 votes in favour, 104 against, 6 abstained (small majority). The opposition (Democratic Alliance) studies an appeal to the Constitutional Court.

2. Duration fifteen years; about three billion cubic metres of gas per year; market price price Worldwide; The Republic finances half of the pipeline, which is estimated to cost about two billion dollars. Structure: verb ⁧تنص⁩ , subject ⁧الاتفاقية⁩ ; ⁧الممتدة⁩ is an adjective (participle) referring to ⁧الاتفاقية⁩ , inserted between commas (the Agreement, of a duration of fifteen years, then ⁧على أن⁩ + conjunctive ⁧تزود⁩ (first clause) and ⁧على أن تتولى⁩ (second clause, ... with the understanding that it is.)
3. a) the Minister for Energy, ⁧قال⁩ and quote quotes (forecast: at least ...); b) the opposition,

⁧شككت⁩ and ⁧معتبرة⁩ ( ḥāl); c) the leader of the Democratic Alliance, with ⁧أعلن⁩ … ⁧بحجة⁩ , denied by the Government ( ⁧وهو ما نفته الحكومة⁩ ); d) experts, with ⁧يرى⁩ … ⁧يحذرون⁩ and modality ⁧قد. بحجة⁩ The reason for the opposition is that it is a party argument: it must be made neutral (by claiming that it is not) or preserved as ...with the argument that is always attributed.

4. That the joint statement of the visit merely spoke of continuing consultations on water, and that the issue could weigh on the implementation of the agreement. In diplomatic language, the formula usually indicates that there is no agreement on the point.

5. Example: The Parliament of the Republic of the Sea has approved with 112 votes against 104 the agreement 15 years on gas with the Kingdom of Oasis. According to the government will reduce the energy bill of 20%; the opposition contests the figures and considers a constitutional appeal. Experts warn about price and water risks.49 words)
B · Listening

1. The central bank raised the main rate by half a point, at 9%, motivating him with pressure persistent inflationarys (source: bank, official fact). The Administrative Court annulled a ministerial decree closing three rural schools on parental appeal; the Ministry may challenge the judgment (not final). Medical sources: at least 15 wounded in clashes near the border; budget not independently verified.

2. The Minister of Foreign Affairs and his Greek counterpart in Athens; the climate is cordial and constructive according to the joint statement. Agreement: strengthening cooperation in tourism and renewable energy and setting up a joint commission. No declared agreement on fisheries: exchange of views and continuation of consultations. The date of the first meeting of the committee remains to be determined.

3. He had parked his car in front of the house and had gone up five minutes; When he came down, the watchman stood I wrote a fine. The guard told him that there it is forbidden to park and asked him if he had seen the sign (he was hidden behind a tree). The guard laughed, told him that for this time he would let him go but not park there anymore: he paid nothing.

· 9. ⁧يُعْرِبُ عَنْ قَلَقِهِ⁩ · ⁧يُدِينُ⁩ · ⁧يُدِينُ بِشِدَّةٍ⁩ · 10. "Franco Club": in diplomacy it indicates differences; the parties openly expressed their views which were not shared.
D · Translation

1. Inflation has fallen to 7,2% on an annual basis last September, against the8,5% of the previous month, according to data from the Central Statistical Institute. 2. The appeal court reduced the judgment of first instance issued against the former official to one year's imprisonment with conditional, while the prosecutor announced that he will resort to cassation. 3. The ceasefire entered into force at midnight following regional mediation, but after a few hours the two sides accused each other of violating it. 4. The final declaration expressed deep concern at the deterioration of the humanitarian situation and urged all parties to facilitate the arrival of aid without obstacles. 5. The President of the Republic is likely to appoint the leader of the winning party to form a coalition government within two weeks of the announcement of the final results. Accuracy points: in 1 ⁧إلى⁩ (final value) and ⁧مقابل⁩ (a) the following points are added: in 2 ⁧تخفيف⁩ • reduce • reduce and ⁧مع وقف التنفيذ⁩ • with the conditional • ⁧فيما⁩ . in 3 ⁧إثر⁩ ... ⁧تبادلا الاتهامات⁩ They accused each other. in 4 ⁧القلق البالغ⁩ Deep concern is being expressed and ⁧حث⁩ It urged (it did not ask) . in 5 ⁧من المرجح⁩ It is likely to be (not of course). An error on one of these points: Accuracy 3; two or more, or an error of meaning (e.g. convicted for former official in 2 as if it were the first final sentence): 2.

Personal answer. Example of attack and some sentences:
⁧والصيادون إلى القضاء⁩ … ⁧البلدية تقر مشروع تحويل الميناء القديم⁩
⁧الجلسة الأولى أمام المحكمة الإدارية الشهر المقبل⁩
⁧صادق المجلس البلدي أمس على مشروع تحويل الميناء القديم إلى منطقة للمشاة تضم متاحف ومحلات⁩
⁧تجارية، بتكلفة تقدر بنحو ٤٠ مليون دولار، وفق بيان صادر عن البلدية. ورفعت جمعية صيادي المدينة⁩
⁧في⁩ .« ⁧يهدد مصدر رزق مئات العائلات⁩ » ⁧دعوى أمام المحكمة الإدارية تطالب فيها بإلغاء القرار، معتبرة أنه⁩
⁧ويتوقع خبير اقتصادي أن يرفع المشروع⁩ .« ⁧فرصة تاريخية⁩ » ⁧المقابل، وصف رئيس البلدية المشروع بأنه⁩
⁧عدد السياح بنسبة ١٥٪ خلال خمس سنوات، لكنه حذر من ارتفاع التكاليف. ومن المقرر أن تعقد المحكمة⁩
⁧جلستها الأولى في القضية الشهر المقبل.⁩

⁧رِزْق⁩ • Support. The tutor checks the mandatory elements: title and subtitle; complete attack with source; iḍāfa of three terms ( ⁧مشروع تحويل الميناء القديم⁩ · ⁧جمعية صيادي المدينة⁩ ); with or without ⁧الذي⁩ ( ⁧دعوى تطالب فيها⁩ …); given with the right preposition ( ⁧بنسبة ١٥٪⁩ ); judicial lexicon ( ⁧رفعت دعوى⁩ · ⁧المحكمة الإدارية⁩ · ⁧جلسة⁩ ); three attribution verbs ( ⁧معتبرة⁩ · ⁧وصف⁩ · ⁧يتوقع⁩ / ⁧حذر⁩ ); a forecast with certainty; no adjectives of the author.
F · Oral production

Evaluated by the tutor with the column: Accuracy (precise sectoral lexicon, correct attributions, Egyptian timing and forms) and Fluidity and interaction (review without reading, reformulation of the position of others, response to an objection, natural reactions in the story and negotiation). For the task 3, the tutor controls in particular the sentences reported (ʾalli inn... ʾalli aʿmil...) and steps of the complaint.
